title: The Letter A — A is for Ark
objective: Students will learn the letter A and its sound using the Bible word Ark.
content: Today we learn the letter A! The letter A makes the sound 'ah' like in the word Ark. Can you say 'ah'?
God told Noah to build a big Ark. An Ark is a very big boat! Noah put all the animals on the Ark to keep them safe from the flood.
The letter A is in many words: Apple, Animal, and Angel. Can you think of other words that start with A?
activity: Trace the letter A with your finger. Color a picture of Noah's Ark. Find things in the room that start with A.
discussion: What sound does the letter A make?
Can you name something that starts with A?
